verdict.rationale: Nix is a local package manager and build system, not a service that collects or holds user data, so privacy-oriented data retention and deletion controls are a category error for this product type. The documented garbage collector and auto-gc remove unused packages from the local Nix store. That is disk and package cleanup, not control over retention of personal or AI-interaction data, so it is not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
